blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Sen. Joel Villanueva has filed a resolution seeking a Senate inquiry to determine whether banks are keeping depositors’ money safe from forged checks and unauthorized withdrawals, and whether depositors who lose funds get timely and fair redress. His filed Senate Resolution No. 785 directing the Senate Committee on Banks to look into the implementation and adequacy of bank safeguards and the effectiveness of regulatory supervision and depositor remedies, in aid of legislation. “Our banks hold the money of our countrymen, and our law is clear that financial institutions have the responsibility to safeguard it.
